sentences.en: How to Reduce Stress.
sentences.zh: 如何减轻压力。
sentences.asr_text: How to Reduce Stress
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Good morning. Today we look at how to reduce stress.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。今天我们来看看如何减轻压力。

sentences.en: As you all know, life always has stressors, er, things which are causing us stress and living without stress is virtually impossible.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，生活中总会有压力源，也就是那些让我们感到压力的事情；完全没有压力的生活几乎不可能。

w.m: n. 压力源；引发压力的因素

sentences.en: So, if we have to live with stress, we may as well find out more about what it is, how we can deal with it and so on.
sentences.zh: 既然必须与压力共处，我们不妨多了解一下它是什么，以及如何应对它等问题。

sentences.en: What is stress then?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是压力呢？

sentences.en: The term was originally used in physics to describe the force exerted between two touching bodies.
sentences.zh: 这个术语最初用于物理学，用来描述两个相互接触的物体之间施加的力。

sentences.en: It was strictly a term describing a physical reaction.
sentences.zh: 当时，它仅仅是一个描述物理反应的术语。

sentences.en: Then in the 1930s, a doctor named Hans Selye, S-e-l-y-e, first used this term to describe a human’s reaction to a demand placed on it, pleasant or not.
sentences.zh: 到了二十世纪三十年代，一位名叫汉斯·塞利的医生——姓氏拼作S-e-l-y-e——首次用这个术语描述人对外界要求所作出的反应，无论这种要求令人愉快与否。

sentences.en: And he included in this response things like accelerated breathing, accelerated heart rate, increased blood pressure, muscle tension and so on.
sentences.zh: 他把呼吸加快、心率加快、血压升高、肌肉紧张等都包括在这种反应之中。

sentences.en: Now, please notice that I said that stress can be pleasant or not.
sentences.zh: 请注意，我刚才说了，压力带来的感受可以愉快，也可以不愉快。

sentences.en: This response can also be pleasant or not, and stress can be both negative and positive.
sentences.zh: 这种反应也可能令人愉快或不愉快，而压力既可以是负面的，也可以是正面的。
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: Let’s take a look at positive stress.
sentences.zh: 我们先来看看正面压力。

sentences.en: Positive stress occurs in a life situation towards which one feels positively.
sentences.zh: 当人们对生活中的某种情境抱有积极感受时，就会产生正面压力。

sentences.en: Things like Christmas or getting married are usually positive events, but still stressful nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 例如圣诞节、结婚通常都是好事，但仍然会让人感到压力。

sentences.en: Another example is that pressure in a job can give some people incentive to work and excitement, but it still is stress.
sentences.zh: 再比如，工作压力可以给一些人带来工作动力和兴奋感，但它仍然是压力。

sentences.en: Negative stress is what most of us think of when we think of stress.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人一提到压力，想到的都是负面压力。

sentences.en: And negative stress occurs logically enough in situations towards which one feels negatively.
sentences.zh: 很自然，当人们对某种情境有消极感受时，就会产生负面压力。

sentences.en: And those examples could be test-taking, a friend’s death and so on.
sentences.zh: 例如参加考试、朋友去世等。

sentences.en: But here a thing to remember is that stress in itself is not hazardous, rather the danger is in the individual’s reaction to the stress.
sentences.zh: 但要记住，压力本身并不危险，危险在于个人对压力的反应。

sentences.en: So psychologists have found that if we develop appropriate ways to cope with stressful situations, individuals can reduce the physiological harm which is caused by stress, or which can be caused by stress.
sentences.zh: 心理学家因此发现，如果我们学会以适当的方式应对压力情境，就能够减轻压力已经造成或可能造成的生理伤害。

sentences.en: And that’s what I want to talk a bit about today: what are these appropriate ways to deal with stress; how to minimize any negative reactions.
sentences.zh: 这就是我今天想谈的内容：有哪些适当的应对压力的方法，以及怎样把负面反应降到最低。
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: The first thing that most psychologists suggest is to learn to recognize your own stress signals.
sentences.zh: 大多数心理学家给出的第一条建议，是学会识别自己的压力信号。

sentences.en: We all have different types of stress signals, but individuals should monitor themselves for stress signals so that they can focus on minimizing or acknowledging the stress before it gets out of control.
sentences.zh: 每个人的压力信号各不相同，但我们都应该留意自身的这些信号，以便在压力失控之前，着手减轻它，或者正视它的存在。

sentences.en: And common early signs for many people include irritability, insomnia, weight loss or even weight gain, smoking, drinking, increases in small errors.
sentences.zh: 许多人常见的早期信号包括烦躁、失眠、体重减轻或增加、吸烟、饮酒，以及小差错增多。

sentences.en: All kinds of things that people get which could be an early signal of stress.
sentences.zh: 人们身上出现的各种情况，都可能是压力的早期信号。

sentences.en: You can consider ways to protect yourself when you start seeing these signs coming on, so you might decide to withdraw from a stressful situation or reward yourself with equal amounts of low stress activity time.
sentences.zh: 开始察觉这些迹象时，就可以考虑如何保护自己。比如，选择暂时离开压力情境，或者奖励自己等量时间，去参加压力较小的活动。
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: That’s really the first important way to deal with stress appropriately.
sentences.zh: 这就是恰当应对压力的第一种重要方法。

sentences.en: A second important way to deal with stress is to pay attention to your body’s demands.
sentences.zh: 第二种重要方法，是关注身体的需要。

sentences.en: Most psychologists are finding that a good exercise program, good nutrition, decreases the amount of stress, or the effect of stress on the body or in the mind.
sentences.zh: 大多数心理学家发现，良好的锻炼安排和合理的营养，能够减轻压力，或者减弱压力对身体和心理的影响。

sentences.en: And this seems quite apparent because exercise can provide a stress-free environment away from your usual stressors, and it keeps your body busy and preoccupied with non-stressful things.
sentences.zh: 这似乎很容易理解：锻炼能提供一个远离日常压力源的无压力环境，还能让身体忙起来，专注于不会造成压力的事情。

w.m: n. 压力源；引发压力的因素

sentences.en: OK. The third thing to reduce stress is to make plans and act when appropriate.
sentences.zh: 第三种减压方法，是在适当的时候制订计划并采取行动。

sentences.en: What is suggested is that rather than wasting energy on worrying, an individual can direct his or her energy to plan the steps and act.
sentences.zh: 这条建议是说，与其把精力浪费在担忧上，不如把它用来规划步骤、采取行动。

sentences.en: And often just the planning of the action helps to reduce the stress because it reduces the worrying.
sentences.zh: 而且，往往只要开始规划行动，就有助于减轻压力，因为这样能够减少担忧。

sentences.en: And also the results of the plans or action may serve to remove or weaken the original cause of the stress.
sentences.zh: 此外，计划或行动的结果，也可能消除或削弱最初造成压力的原因。

sentences.en: Please notice that I just now said when appropriate, and this next suggestion has to do with that idea of when appropriate.
sentences.zh: 请注意，我刚才说的是“在适当的时候”，而下一条建议就与“什么时候才算适当”有关。

sentences.en: The third suggestion was to make plans and act when appropriate, rather than just sit around and worry.
sentences.zh: 第三条建议是：在适当的时候制订计划并行动，而不是干坐着担忧。

sentences.en: But the fourth plan or fourth idea says to learn to accept situations which are out of your control.
sentences.zh: 第四条建议则是：学会接受自己无法控制的情况。

sentences.en: These two then go hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 这两条建议是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: You can make plans and act when it’s appropriate, but when it’s not appropriate or when it’s impossible, the only way is to learn to accept that some things are unchangeable, and out of your hands.
sentences.zh: 时机合适时，可以制订计划并行动；而时机不合适，或者根本无法行动时，唯一的办法就是学会接受：有些事是改变不了、也不由你掌控的。

sentences.en: So, for example, if you are in traffic, lateness caused by traffic is out of your hands.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你碰上堵车，由此造成的迟到就不是你能控制的。

w.m: phr.身处车流中（这里指遇上堵车）

sentences.en: There is no sense in getting really crazy about that.
sentences.zh: 为这件事急得发狂，并没有意义。

sentences.en: If you do so, it only increases your stress to waste energy trying to resist what’s inevitable, or what can’t be avoided.
sentences.zh: 如果这样做，把精力浪费在抗拒无法避免的事情上，只会增加自己的压力。
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: The last item that psychologists suggest is to pace your activities.
sentences.zh: 心理学家最后一条建议，是安排好活动的节奏。

sentences.en: By pace I mean giving yourself some manageable task to do at a reasonable speed.
sentences.zh: 这里的“安排节奏”，是指给自己安排能够应付的任务，以合理的速度去完成。

sentences.en: That is, you go at a speed that you can handle.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，按自己能够承受的速度去做。

sentences.en: Break your task into manageable parts, rather than try to deal with the whole task all at once.
sentences.zh: 把任务分成若干能够应付的小部分，而不是试图一次完成整个任务。

sentences.en: So as an example in your lives as students, a whole term paper might feel overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 以学生生活为例，一整篇学期论文可能让你觉得无从下手、难以招架。

sentences.en: But if you say to yourself: today I’m going to the library and gather resources; tomorrow I’m going to read three articles, and so on, you will have broken this one large task, that’s writing a term paper, down into many smaller and more manageable tasks.
sentences.zh: 但如果你告诉自己：今天去图书馆找资料，明天读三篇文章，以此类推，那么，你就把写学期论文这一项大任务，分解成了许多更小、更容易完成的任务。

sentences.en: This will certainly reduce your stress.
sentences.zh: 这肯定能够减轻你的压力。

sentences.en: OK. Having said all these, I want you to remember that the problem is not in the stressful experiences themselves.
sentences.zh: 说了这么多，我希望大家记住：问题并不在于那些带来压力的经历本身。

sentences.en: We all experience stress and stressful events.
sentences.zh: 我们都会承受压力，都会遇到令人有压力的事情。

sentences.en: The problem is in our reactions to these experiences.
sentences.zh: 问题在于我们如何对这些经历作出反应。

sentences.en: And each of us has our own limits for stress and our own ways of coping with stress.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人承受压力的限度都不同，应对压力的方式也各不相同。

sentences.en: So long as we have our own appropriate ways, stress or stressful situations can certainly be dealt with.
sentences.zh: 只要找到适合自己的方法，就一定能够应对压力或压力情境。

sentences.en: OK. That’s all for today’s lecture. See you next week.
sentences.zh: 今天的讲座就到这里，下周见。

sentences.en: Now, you have three minutes to check your work.
sentences.zh: 现在你有三分钟检查作答。
sentences.asr_text: Now? You have three minutes to check your work.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: This is the end of Section A mini-lecture.
sentences.zh: A节短讲到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of Section A Mini Lecture
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: First of all thank you obviously for your time, Angelina.
sentences.zh: 首先，安吉丽娜，谢谢您抽时间接受采访。
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: You are now in Iraq. So what is your main aim in this visit?
sentences.zh: 您现在人在伊拉克。那么，这次访问的主要目的是什么？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: What are you trying to accomplish while you are out here?
sentences.zh: 来到这里，您希望达成什么目标？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well I came to the region about 6 months ago.
sentences.zh: 大约六个月前，我曾经来过这个地区。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: I first went to Syria because I work with U.N.H.C.R. and there are 1.5 million refugees in Syria alone from Iraq
sentences.zh: 我先去了叙利亚，因为我与联合国难民署合作，而仅在叙利亚就有一百五十万来自伊拉克的难民。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: and while I was there, I went inside and met with some internally displaced people.
sentences.zh: 而在那期间，我还到境内走访，会见了一些境内流离失所者。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: You know, these are the people made homeless because of the war.
sentences.zh: 这些人因为战争而失去了家园。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: They are refugees and this trip is to get a better picture of the internally displaced people and to discuss the situation with the local government, with our government, with the NGOs and with local people and try to understand what is happening,
sentences.zh: 他们是难民；这次访问是为了更全面地了解境内流离失所者的情况，与当地政府、我国政府、非政府组织以及当地民众讨论现状，努力弄清楚正在发生什么。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: because there are over 2 million internally displaced people and there doesn’t seem to be a real coherent plan to help them and there’s lots of good will and lots of discussion — but just a lot of talk at the moment and a lot of pieces need to be put together.
sentences.zh: 因为境内流离失所者超过两百万人，但似乎还没有一个真正协调一致的援助计划。虽然有很多善意，也有很多讨论，但目前还多停留在口头上，许多环节仍需要整合。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: So, trying to figure out what they are.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想弄清楚具体需要整合哪些环节。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: What kind of a sense have you been able to get so far in terms of how severe the crisis is and what actually needs to be done to help out?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，对于危机有多严重，以及具体需要做些什么来提供帮助，您了解到什么情况？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well, I in my research before I came here, I looked at the numbers and there are over 4 million people displaced and of the 2 million internally displaced it’s estimated that 58 percent are under 12 years old.
sentences.zh: 来之前做调查时，我看了相关数字：流离失所的人超过四百万；而在其中两百万境内流离失所者中，估计有百分之五十八是十二岁以下的儿童。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: So it’s a very high number of people in a very, very vulnerable situation and a lot of young kids.
sentences.zh: 所以，处境极其脆弱的人数非常多，其中还有很多年幼的孩子。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: So far the different officials I’ve met with and different local people I’ve met with all have shared concerns and very strongly, you know, they have spoken out about the humanitarian crisis but um, there seems to be a block in.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我会见的不同官员和当地民众都有共同的担忧，也都强烈呼吁关注这场人道主义危机；但是，事情似乎卡在了某个环节。

w.m: phr.公开表明立场；大声疾呼

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: I’m not good at policy and fixing all this and saying what’s wrong.
sentences.zh: 我不擅长政策，也不擅长解决这一切，或指出问题究竟出在哪里。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: But I do know that for example U.N.H.C.R. needs to be more active inside Iraq.
sentences.zh: 但我确实知道，例如联合国难民署就需要在伊拉克境内更积极地开展工作。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: How do you think U.N.H.C.R. should be doing?
sentences.zh: 您认为联合国难民署应该怎样开展工作？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well, I don’t have the answers but I know that this is one thing that needs to be addressed and solved because there does need to be a real presence here to help count the people and register the people.
sentences.zh: 我没有现成的答案，但我知道这是必须处理和解决的问题之一，因为这里确实需要有机构实实在在地开展工作，帮助统计人数，并为这些人登记。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: This is the end of part one of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第一部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part one of the interview.

units.title: 采访：伊拉克流离失所者（下）

sentences.en: Now. Listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 现在请听访谈的第二部分。
sentences.asr_text: Now. Listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Questions 6 to 10 are based on part 2 of the interview.
sentences.zh: 第6至10题根据访谈的第二部分提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions 6 to 10 are based on part 2 of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Do you think the global community has a responsibility to address that?
sentences.zh: 您认为国际社会有责任解决这一问题吗？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well, I think the global community always has a responsibility to any humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 我认为，面对任何人道主义危机，国际社会都有责任采取行动。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: And I think it’s in our best interest to address a humanitarian crisis on this scale because displacement can lead to a lot of instability and aggression.
sentences.zh: 而且，解决如此大规模的人道主义危机，也最符合我们自身的利益，因为人口流离失所可能引发严重的动荡和攻击行为。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: We certainly don’t want that.
sentences.zh: 这显然是我们不希望看到的。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: A lot of people feel it’s a little calmer now... this is the time to really discuss and, and try to get these communities back together.
sentences.zh: 很多人觉得，现在局势稍微平静了一些……正是时候认真讨论，努力让这些社区重新团结起来。

w.m: phr.让这些社区重新团结起来

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: But if these communities don’t start coming back together properly, if we don’t start really counting the people... understanding where they are... what they need...
sentences.zh: 但如果这些社区没有开始妥善地重新凝聚起来，如果我们没有真正开始统计人数，了解他们在哪里、需要什么……
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: making sure the schools are being built... making sure the electricity, the water and all these needs are being met
sentences.zh: 确保学校得到建设，确保供电、供水以及其他各项需求得到满足……
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: and also understanding that a lot of the people that will return are going to come back to houses that are occupied or destroyed and bombed out...
sentences.zh: 同时还要认识到，许多准备返回的人会发现，自己的房屋已经被占用、被毁坏，或被炸得无法居住……

w.m: phr.被炸毁；被炸得无法居住

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: It’s going to be a big operation to understand the needs... to address it, to help people put the pieces of their life back together and return to their communities.
sentences.zh: 了解这些需求、着手解决问题，帮助人们重新拼起破碎的生活、回到自己的社区，将是一项庞大的工作。

w.h: put the pieces of one's life back together

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: So it’s really just getting the plan together... getting the group together and everybody actively focused on helping the refugees.
sentences.zh: 所以，关键就在于统筹好计划，组织好团队，让每个人都积极投入帮助难民的工作。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: What would be the message that you would want to carry out of here back home or even the message that you would want to get out internationally in terms of what’s happening here... the refugee crisis... the consequences that could happen in the future if it’s not properly addressed?
sentences.zh: 您希望从这里带回国内怎样的信息，或者说，向国际社会传递怎样的信息，内容涉及这里正在发生的事情、这场难民危机，以及如果处理不当将来可能带来的后果？

w.m: phr. 带回国内；回到本国

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: I always hate speculation on the news, so I don’t want to be somebody who speculates.
sentences.zh: 我一向不喜欢新闻中的猜测，因此也不想成为随意猜测的人。
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: Um but I think it’s clear that a displaced unstable population is what happens in Iraq, and how Iraq settles in the years to come is going to affect the entire Middle East.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很清楚，伊拉克目前存在着大量流离失所、生活不稳定的人口；而伊拉克在未来几年如何安定下来，将影响整个中东。

w.m: adj.流离失所的；被迫离家的

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: And a big part of what is going to affect how it settles is how these people are returned and settled into their homes into their community and brought back together
sentences.zh: 影响伊拉克如何安定下来的一个重要因素，就是这些人将如何返回、如何在家园和社区安顿下来并重新聚在一起。
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: and whether they can live together and what their communities look like, so it does have broad implications.
sentences.zh: 还包括他们能否共同生活，以及他们的社区会是什么样子。因此，这件事的影响确实很广泛。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: On a personal level why is this so important to you... you willing to come here and risk your life?
sentences.zh: 从您个人的角度来说，为什么这件事如此重要，值得您冒着生命危险来到这里？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Uh, it was a very easy choice to make.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这个选择很容易作出。
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.asr_ref: 核验/正文清理/2014-局部真词锚.json

sentences.en: I felt I had to come here because it is very difficult to get answers about especially the internally displaced people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己必须来，因为要了解情况、尤其是了解境内流离失所者的情况，实在非常困难。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: It’s as I said even U.N.H.C.R. who I traditionally work with — they are not able to be inside at the moment
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，就连一直与我合作的联合国难民署，目前都无法在境内开展工作。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: and so I was very frustrated and just getting a bunch of ideas and papers but not knowing what’s really going on,
sentences.zh: 因此，我感到很沮丧：收到的只是许多想法和书面材料，却不知道实际发生着什么。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: so today I’m able to talk to all different people from our government and their government and really get some answers as to what is holding up the processes to really assist these people properly.
sentences.zh: 所以，今天我能与我国政府和伊拉克政府的不同人员交谈，真正弄清楚：究竟是什么拖延了程序，使这些人迟迟得不到妥善援助。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Do you think that you in your position can try to push this process forward, but... pressure perhaps on our government?
sentences.zh: 您认为，凭借您的地位，能否推动这个进程，比如……也许可以向我国政府施压？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: To put pressure on our government?
sentences.zh: 向我国政府施压？
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Yes, or to try to just put pressure in general... create awareness?
sentences.zh: 对，或者只是从总体上施加一些压力……让大家关注这件事？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: I certainly think creating awareness.
sentences.zh: 我当然认为，提高大家的关注度很重要。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: I spoke to the officials from our government today about meeting our goal and they still intend to reach that goal.
sentences.zh: 今天，我和我国政府官员谈到了实现目标的问题，他们仍然打算达成这一目标。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: You know there are many different people who can be cynical or say well how are they going to do it, and I will ask them how are you going to do it and is there some way we can help to... you know.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会冷嘲热讽，或者说：“他们打算怎么做到呢？”而我会直接问他们：“你们打算怎么做到？我们有没有办法帮忙……”

w.m: adj.冷嘲热讽的；不相信他人诚意的

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: OK. Thank you Angelina for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 好的。安吉丽娜，谢谢您接受我们的采访。
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Pleasure.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能接受采访。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part two of the interview.

sentences.en: Question 6. Why should the global community help address the refugee problem?
sentences.zh: 为什么国际社会应该协助解决难民问题？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer
sentences.question_sync_basis: 对应已核考试试卷stem；含实际口述Question题号。

sentences.en: Question 7. What is NOT mentioned by Angelina in terms of helping refugees?
sentences.zh: 在帮助难民方面，安吉丽娜没有提到哪一项？
sentences.speaker: Question announcer
sentences.question_sync_basis: 对应已核考试试卷stem；含实际口述Question题号。

manual_splits.en: And I think it’s in our best interest to address a humanitarian crisis on this scale because displacement can lead to a lot of instability and aggression.
zh: 而且，解决如此大规模的人道主义危机，也最符合我们自身的利益，
因为人口流离失所可能引发严重的动荡和攻击行为。
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: But if these communities don’t start coming back together properly, if we don’t start really counting the people... understanding where they are... what they need...
zh: 但如果这些社区没有开始妥善地重新凝聚起来，
如果我们没有真正开始统计人数，了解他们在哪里、需要什么……
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: What would be the message that you would want to carry out of here back home or even the message that you would want to get out internationally in terms of what’s happening here... the refugee crisis... the consequences that could happen in the future if it’s not properly addressed?
zh: 您希望从这里带回国内怎样的信息，
或者说，向国际社会传递怎样的信息，内容涉及这里正在发生的事情、这场难民危机，
以及如果处理不当将来可能带来的后果？
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: Um but I think it’s clear that a displaced unstable population is what happens in Iraq, and how Iraq settles in the years to come is going to affect the entire Middle East.
zh: 但我认为很清楚，伊拉克目前存在着大量流离失所、生活不稳定的人口；
而伊拉克在未来几年如何安定下来，将影响整个中东。
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: And a big part of what is going to affect how it settles is how these people are returned and settled into their homes into their community and brought back together
manual_splits.at: is how these people are returned
zh: 影响伊拉克如何安定下来的一个重要因素，
就是这些人将如何返回、如何在家园和社区安顿下来并重新聚在一起。
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: so today I’m able to talk to all different people from our government and their government and really get some answers as to what is holding up the processes to really assist these people properly.
zh: 所以，今天我能与我国政府和伊拉克政府的不同人员交谈，
真正弄清楚：究竟是什么拖延了程序，使这些人迟迟得不到妥善援助。
manual_splits.evidence: 核验/2010-2015-长句分屏语义预审.json；逐屏中英/词注人工语义审查，换屏另核真实词首与原音guard；不得伪称纯静音。

manual_splits.en: You know there are many different people who can be cynical or say well how are they going to do it, and I will ask them how are you going to do it and is there some way we can help to... you know.
zh: 有些人可能会冷嘲热讽，或者说：“他们打算怎么做到呢？”
而我会直接问他们：“你们打算怎么做到？我们有没有办法帮忙……”
